mapper.select: select n.notification_id, n.actor_shop_user_id, case when n.actor_shop_user_id is null then '甄客行运营' else coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), '甄客用户') end actor_name, u.avatar actor_avatar, n.event_type, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.target_title, n.content_preview, case n.target_type when 'POST' then concat('/posts/', n.target_id) when 'REPORT' then concat('/reports/', n.target_id) else null end target_path, case when n.actor_shop_user_id is null then 1 else 0 end system_generated, case when n.read_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end is_read, n.read_time, n.create_time from shop_notification n left join shop_user u on u.user_id = n.actor_shop_user_id where n.recipient_shop_user_id = #{recipientShopUserId} order by n.create_time desc, n.notification_id desc
select count(1) from shop_notification where recipient_shop_user_id = #{recipientShopUserId} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into shop_notification (recipient_shop_user_id, actor_shop_user_id, event_type, target_type, target_id, source_id, target_title, content_preview, dedupe_key, read_flag, create_time) values (#{recipientShopUserId}, #{actorShopUserId}, #{eventType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{sourceId}, #{targetTitle}, #{contentPreview}, #{dedupeKey}, '0', sysdate()) on duplicate key update notification_id = notification_id
mapper.update: update shop_notification set read_flag = '1', read_time = coalesce(read_time, sysdate()) where recipient_shop_user_id = #{recipientShopUserId} and read_flag = '0'
